name: lorekiln
description: Deterministic local dialogue journaling, a governed experience pool, separate engineering application history, and explicitly authorized capability evolution.

interface.shortDescription: Journal evidence; govern and retrieve experience on request.
interface.longDescription: Persist every completed turn locally without model calls, organize reusable approved lessons in a cross-session domain experience pool, record engineering applications independently, retrieve both progressively, and require verified rollback snapshots plus separate user authorization and acceptance for capability changes.
defaultPrompt: Distill reusable lessons and biases from this work.
Save all uncommitted dialogue through the current completed turn as a memory anchor.
Show the compact index of approved experience in a named domain, then expand selected records.
Modify the named Skill or plugin from approved experience, with a change report and tests.
